claim: According to Harry Roque, even if 10,000 people die, 10 million COVID-19 cases in the country will not be a loss.
evidence: In a virtual press conference on August 11, Roque refuted the claim, stating that it was "very different" from his statement. He reminded people to just follow his official Facebook page or the one for his office if they wanted updates.
